The severity might be slightly underestimated (could be 2.5-3.0) because this 'smoothness' is a hallmark of AI generation failing to capture industrial complexity. The 'structural_collapse' of the stand (severity 1.0) is also valid; it lacks a proper footplate. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found only slight compression, missing the structural/textural 'uncanny valley' effect that the Router caught. alignment_reasoning: The image is a high-fidelity representation of a plow structurally. The Fine Grained Classifier confirmed the class with high confidence (logit 7.77). All functional components (hitch, moldboards, coulters) are present and geometrically plausible. Points were deducted only because the 'material' checkpoint failed (no soil/weathering) and the 'penetrating ground' context is missing, though the latter is excusable due to isolation. It is a perfect *model* of a plow, but an imperfect *photograph* of one.
artifact_reasoning: The primary defect is the 'CAD-like' smoothness (texture anomaly). Real steel plows have complex surface details (welds, bolt heads, rust, scratches) which are absent here, giving it a synthetic, plastic appearance. The floating shadow/stand issue adds to the artificiality. While the geometry is sound (confirmed by depth/topology experts), the lack of photorealistic material fidelity prevents a high artifact score. It resembles a product catalog render more than a natural image.
